artworks.title: El Palacio de las Palomas, Uxmal (The Palace of the Pigeons, Uxmal)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a view from slightly above ground level displaying an ancient linear structure made of pyramid-like stone shapes, some covered with plants. An archway stands prominently among the formations. Figures in white clothing and hats are scattered among dry vegetation, with a pile of stones on the left. The scene has a sepia tone, creating an antique feel.

artworks.title: Nude Study
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation

artworks.title: The Logan Rock, South Coast of Cornwall
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky cliff photographed from a side, slightly elevated point of view, with a person standing on the large boulders near the top. The horizon is mostly obscured by the massive rock formation. The texture of the rocks is rough and weathered. The color palette is earthy and muted, with a historical or vintage feel. The sky above is a uniform light hue, contrasting with the darker tones of the rock face and soil.

artworks.title: Portraits of a Girl and a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a diptych featuring two children. The left side shows a young child seated in a wicker chair, with their full body visible. They have round facial features, softly curving hair, and are wearing a patterned dress. The right side features another child standing beside a small table draped with an ornate cloth, with a straw hat featuring a ribbon detail placed on top. This child's full body is also visible, and they have similar facial features and hairstyle to the seated child. The child is dressed in a buttoned suit with a white collar. Both photos have a textured, dark background and are presented in matching decorative frames with gold accents, mounted together within a reddish-brown case.

artworks.title: Geoffroy-Dechaume's Angel of the eastern gable of Sainte-Chapelle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The sculpture shows a standing figure with wings on its back. The figure wears a long robe and holds a staff with a cross at the top. The sculpture is placed outdoors in front of a stone wall with gothic architectural elements, such as an arched window. The material of the sculpture contrasts with the surrounding architecture. The angel faces forward with a neutral and serene expression. There are debris and stones around the sculpture's base.

artworks.title: Nude
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: These are two identical sepia-toned photographs placed next to each other. The photographs show a woman lying reclined on a bed. She is positioned on her side, her head towards the left and propped up on one of her hands. She is looking out at us. She has pale skin and long, dark hair that cascades over her shoulders. The woman appears to be nude, but upon closer inspection it seems she is wearing a sheer garment. Behind her seems to be a large mirror, showing us the back of her body. The setting is framed by white drapes or curtains with a floral pattern, and the bed beneath her has thin brown posts and a gray knitted or crocheted blanket with some white spots. The two photographs are contained in square framed with rounded corners on the top, and they are next to each other on a black surface with a purple border.

artworks.title: Taj Mahal from the East
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a low-angle view of the Taj Mahal against a light sky. Stone ruins are in the left foreground, contrasting with the smooth Taj Mahal in the distance. The color palette is sepia, contributing to a historical feel. The upper half of the image shows the sky with soft tones. An empty riverbed is on the right.

artworks.title: Taj Mahal from the East
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure resembling the Taj Mahal in the distance. The view is slightly elevated. The horizon is not clearly visible. Domes and minarets stand out against a dark upper portion. The image is presented in a negative style. Closest are worn brick ruins. A river curves past the ruins. There is a large river separating the ruins from the architecture. The color palette is primarily inverted with dark tones dominating the sky and lighter shades defining the river, ruins, and the Taj Mahal.

artworks.title: La Tour des Vents, Athènes (The Tower of the Winds, Athens)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image depicts a historical view of Athens, with the Tower of the Winds featured prominently. Various ancient and modern structures are visible, along with rolling hills in the background. The Tower of the Winds is detailed with columns and reliefs, surrounded by other buildings. Additional structures can be seen in the distance, and a cypress tree adds vertical contrast. The monochromatic palette of sepia tones gives the scene an aged quality and highlights light and shadow.

artworks.title: Temple at Hallibeed, India
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows an old stone structure surrounded by nature. The scene features intricate architecture and sprawling tree roots. The roots cascade down the carvings on the structure, blending with nature. The building has multiple tiers adorned with statues and carvings, giving it an ancient appearance. The stone surfaces are textured and weathered, with a soft focus suggesting an aged photograph. The tones are predominantly sepia, creating a historic feel. The vegetation is dense and wild, both around and upon the stone structures, adding to the impression of abandonment and nature's encroachment. The image captures the combination of art and nature in earthy hues.

artworks.title: The Mill-Dam
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a rustic stone and wooden structure beneath a rocky outcrop. The viewpoint is slightly above eye level, revealing the sturdy stonework framing an entrance to a mine or cave-like opening. Small shrubs and saplings cling to the rock slopes above the structure. The color palette consists of earthy tones like deep browns and grays, enhancing the natural setting.

artworks.title: Temple, Chitradurga, India
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows architectural ruins on a hillside with large boulders. The horizon is hidden by the hill in the background. There are stone structures, including a rectangular building, a tall column on a platform, and an archway that seems to be an entrance. Steps lead up to a more elaborate building with columns and sculptural details, partially obscured by trees. The setting is monochromatic with sepia tones, emphasizing the historical appearance of the structures. The image shows the rough texture of the stone and natural terrain juxtaposed with architectural details.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a slight turn to their left, their head facing forward and right hand resting on the back of a chair. The individual has subtle facial features with a calm expression, and dark hair mostly covered by a veil. They are wearing a long, flowing white dress with layers and a high collar, along with a white veil that drapes over their shoulders and down their back. A ribbon or sash is tied at their waist. The subject is holding a small object or flower in their right hand. The background is plain and dark, and the subject stands out prominently in the framed photograph. The image is bordered by a decorative frame with gold and dark colors.

artworks.title: New Lock, Hurley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a river landscape with a person on the right side and a boat with a person rowing on the left side. The river curves into the distance, leading to a horizon with a line of trees. On the right, there is dense woodland, while the left bank has open fields and scattered trees. The image conveys a serene and reflective mood with calm water and a quiet boat.

artworks.title: The Chapter House, St. Mary's Abbey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Charles T. Isaacs
artworks.description: The image shows the remains of a structure, with a stone wall forming a horizontal line near the bottom. Ruined columns and carved stones are in the foreground, with foliage partially covering the rest of the structure behind them. Additional arches are visible in the background. The upper part of the image features the silhouettes of tree branches and leaves. The sepia tone gives an aged look, with a brown color palette. The overall impression is one of historical interest and serenity, emphasizing the contrast between the stone structure and the natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Spring Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level natural scene. In the foreground, there is a muddy path surrounded by lush foliage, with broad-leafed plants on each side. Further back, there are various trees, some upright and others leaning, scattered around and casting faint shadows. The horizon is high, below a subtle mist, with trees reaching towards it. The image has a soft focus and a vintage appearance with a sepia-toned palette.

artworks.title: McAllister's Optical Shop, Philadelphia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an urban street scene with several multi-story buildings. The image captures a row of buildings with various businesses on their ground floors, identifiable by signs on the facades. The architecture features numerous windows, many of which have shutters. The second building displays signs reading 'McAllister & Co.' with items visible through the windows and signs advertising services such as 'CARD & JOB PRINTING'. The scene is devoid of human figures but suggests activity through the open shutters and displayed store signs. The photograph is presented in an elegant frame.

artworks.title: Arch St. Theatre, Arch at 6th St., Philadelphia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a neoclassical building with columns and a pediment. The building features a façade with columns supporting a triangular pediment, adorned with a sculptural relief depicting a classical figure with a shield and a chariot. Below the pediment are rectangular windows, and beneath them is a balcony with a balustrade railing. A lamp post can be seen near the entrance, with steps leading up to several doorways. Signs indicate it is likely a public venue, possibly a theater, given the poster advertising performances. The photograph is in sepia tone, giving it a historic quality.

artworks.title: Fountain at Sultan Ahmed Mosque, Istanbul
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an architectural structure featuring an ornate facade with detailed carvings, a domed roof, smaller domes, arches with geometric and floral patterns, sculptures and possibly Arabic script. The foreground shows a cobbled stone surface with baskets and barrels. The play of light and shadows accentuates the building's elaborate details and textures.

artworks.title: Convent of Mar Saba
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient architectural complex in a rugged landscape. The structures are built with stone, showcasing rectangular forms and arches. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones like browns, beiges, and grays. The buildings are integrated into the surroundings, with natural rock formations blending harmoniously with the structures.

artworks.title: On the River Mole, Surrey
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a pond or waterway with calm waters reflecting the sky and foliage. Lily pads are scattered on the water's surface. A large tree is on the right, and shrubs and smaller trees frame the left side of the water. Rolling hills are visible in the distance, blending with a pale, overcast sky. A person in a white shirt and hat is bending near the water's edge, partially hidden by vegetation. The image is in sepia tones, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Horace and Edward Stalking Stags
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a grassy landscape. The image shows a high ground covered with dense grass, stretching evenly across. On the right side, some items are partially visible above the grass. In the background, elements on the right side appear to protrude above the grass in a horn-like shape. The terrain descends slightly from left to right, offering a subtle sense of depth and elevation. Overall, the image captures a serene open field or moorland.

artworks.title: The King's Temples, Ulwar
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of an ornate architectural structure. The building is characterized by intricate arches and domes. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, allowing the viewer to see the entire length of the structure as it spans from left to right. Trees obscure the horizon line, blending into rocky hills in the background. The image is a sepia-toned photograph, giving it a vintage quality. The color palette is mainly shades of brown. In the distance, rocky formations contrast with the smooth surfaces of the building. A smaller pavilion's dome is visible in the foreground, adding more architectural interest to the scene.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Egyptian Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in a side profile. She is dressed in a long, draped garment that covers most of her body, including her head and a veil covering her face, leaving only her eyes visible. Her hair is not visible due to the head covering. She has a textured garment underneath with intricate patterns on the sleeves. In her right hand, she holds a large, round-necked clay jug at shoulder height, supported by her left hand. A metallic ornament band adorns her forehead. The background is a plain, textured surface.
